subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` contract now with this doctor migration, rather than preserve the contract by implementing real gRPC exporters?
rationale: Both paths resolve the mismatch, but changing a shipped documented config contract and intentionally disabling telemetry during some repairs requires owner intent that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Retire grpc with migration
options.body: Approve the validation narrowing and doctor repair because the advertised value has never had a working exporter path.

options.title: Implement gRPC exporters
options.body: Keep the shipped config value and replace this PR with real trace, metric, and log gRPC exporter support.

options.title: Defer the contract change
options.body: Leave the mismatch temporarily while a separately tracked diagnostics roadmap decides transport support.

recommendation.title: Retire grpc with migration
recommendation.body: Approve the validation narrowing and doctor repair because the advertised value has never had a working exporter path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest available recent history on the central config contract and documentation surface.
